title: 第五章 如何选择第六章 凶威骇人
content_zh:
;;
文才和秋生从九叔怀里接过秦尧，一人架着一个胳膊，将其抬向厢房。
四目深吸一口气，努力压下想要骂人的冲动，脸上强挤出一抹笑容：“师兄，我想给你商量一件事儿。”
“什么事儿？”
四目：“你刚刚也看到了，秦尧天生就是修炼请神术的好苗子，且以他的体魄来说，武法双修必然是最好的结果。在这两方面，我都是行家……”
“说重点。”九叔隐隐间猜出了他的想法，脸色一沉。
在他锐利如剑的目光注视下，四目倍感压力，暗中放弃了说服九叔让秦尧改换师父的想法，笑着说道：“重点是，我想带秦尧离开，悉心培养，未来茅山定会因此多出一员能打硬仗的无双战将。”
“想都别想。”九叔断然拒绝。
“师兄，茅山需要出现这么一个人，秦尧自己也需要一个成长的平台，你不能因为自己的优柔寡断负了师门，负了徒弟。”四目劝说道。
九叔罕见的生气了，抓起四目衣裳，将其拉到自己面前，冷肃说道：“你明不明白什么叫做师父？一日为师，终身为父！我能接受他胸无大志，能接受他碌碌无为，唯独不能接受有人将他往火炕里面推。”
“那怎么能是火坑呢？最多是危险一点。”四目有些气短心虚，轻声反驳：“可是不经磨砺，如何炼成真金？”
“嘭。”
九叔一拳打在四目脸上，将其硬生生打翻在地：“再说一句，以后就别来见我！”
四目难以置信地望着九叔决绝离开的背影，直接被打懵了。
如果他没记错的话，这是师兄自从他们下山后第一次打他。
至于吗？
他真没什么坏心思啊！
另一边。
九叔刚刚走进大堂，就看到两双带着探究意味的目光。
“师父，茅山出事了吗？”秋生轻声问道。

九叔摇了摇头，说道：“没事儿。茅山天上有人，地下有人，能有什么事情？别瞎操心。”
说着，他微微一顿，伸手拍了拍二人肩膀：“你们好好生活。将来娶妻生子，平平安安，幸福安乐的过完一生，就是最圆满的结果。”
二人似懂非懂，下意识点头回应。
当夜。
月明星稀，虫鸣阵阵。
四目孤身一人坐在义庄院子里，抬头望着苍穹内的皎皎明月，形单影只，清冷寂寥。
大堂门后，九叔面带犹豫的望着他身影，迟迟无法迈出一步。
经过一个多时辰的缓冲，他现在也冷静下来，意识到自己可能有些反应过激了。但让他主动去道歉，一时间又拉不下脸面。
“师兄，对不起。”这时，四目突然转头望向大堂方向，诚恳说道：“是我忽略了你的感受。”
九叔松了一口气，抬步跨过门槛：“我也要向你道歉，不管怎么说，都不该打你。”
随后，师兄弟二人相视一笑，白日时的那点不快顷刻间烟消云散。
……

Wen Cai and Qiu Sheng took Qin Yao from Uncle Jiu's arms, each holding an arm, and carried him to the side room.
Simu took a deep breath, tried hard to suppress the urge to curse, and forced a smile on his face: "Brother, I want to discuss something with you."
"What's going on?"
Four Eyes: "As you just saw, Qin Yao is born to be a good candidate for practicing the art of inviting gods, and considering his physique, practicing both martial arts and martial arts must be the best result. I am an expert in these two aspects..."
"Tell me the important point." Uncle Jiu vaguely guessed what he was thinking, and his face darkened.
Under his sharp sword-like gaze, his eyes felt more pressure. He secretly gave up the idea of persuading Uncle Jiu to let Qin Yao change his master. He said with a smile: "The point is, I want to take Qin Yao away and train him carefully. In the future, Maoshan will definitely have one more unparalleled warrior who can fight tough battles."
"Don't even think about it." Uncle Jiu flatly refused.
"Senior brother, Maoshan needs such a person, and Qin Yao himself also needs a platform to grow. You can't let the master or the apprentice down because of your indecision." Simu persuaded.
Uncle Jiu became angry in a rare way. He grabbed his four-eye clothes, pulled them in front of him, and said coldly: "Do you understand what a master is? Once a teacher, always a father! I can accept that he has no ambitions, and I can accept that he is mediocre, but I can't accept someone pushing him into the hot bed."
"How can it be a fire pit? It's at most dangerous." Simu, a little short of breath and guilty, softly retorted: "But without tempering, how can you refine it into real gold?"
"Bang."
Uncle Jiu punched Simu in the face and knocked him to the ground: "One more thing, don't come to see me in the future!"
He looked at Uncle Jiu's back with disbelief as he decided to leave, and was immediately stunned.
If he remembered correctly, this was the first time the senior brother had hit him since they came down the mountain.
As for that?
He really doesn’t have any bad intentions!
other side.
As soon as Uncle Jiu walked into the lobby, he saw two pairs of inquiring eyes.
"Master, has something happened in Maoshan?" Qiu Sheng asked softly.
Uncle Jiu shook his head and said, "It's okay. There are people in the sky and underground in Maoshan. What can happen? Don't worry about it."
As he said that, he paused for a moment, then reached out and patted the two of them on the shoulders: "You guys live a good life. In the future, marrying a wife and having children, living a peaceful and happy life is the most satisfactory result."
The two of them seemed to understand, and subconsciously nodded in response.
That night.
The moon is sparse and stars are scattered, and insects are chirping.
Sitting alone in the yard of Yizhuang, looking up at the bright moon in the sky, he was alone, cold and lonely.
Behind the lobby door, Uncle Jiu looked at his figure hesitantly, unable to take a step.
After more than an hour of buffering, he now calmed down and realized that he might have overreacted. But for him to take the initiative to apologize, he couldn't lose face for a while.
"Senior brother, I'm sorry." At this moment, he suddenly turned his head to look in the direction of the lobby and said sincerely: "I ignored your feelings."
Uncle Jiu breathed a sigh of relief and stepped across the threshold: "I also want to apologize to you. No matter what, I shouldn't have hit you."
Then, the two junior brothers looked at each other and smiled, and the unhappiness they felt during the day disappeared in an instant.
